title: land waits for a finished headless worker's SessionEnd hook before refusing a live process in its worktree
goal: Found in SP-d3hybrlv: right after the headless worker of ST-7yahfn3j exited, land stopped at step branch naming a live python3 in its worktree (the session's own end hook, gone seconds later); a rerun landed. land waits a bounded time for a process whose parent claude session has exited before refusing, and names it as a hook when it is one.
notes: Merged from ST-5oruclxm “selfcheck's orphans check names a session-end query-log distill hook as such instead of failing on it” at the 2026-10-10 backlog triage: Same root as ST-iltxwoty: a session-end distill process (seconds old, reparented to pid 1) must be named as a hook in flight with its age and not fail selfcheck/procs while young; absorb the bl_procs/bl_selfcheck half and its planted test (young distill passes, old stray still fails); no premise change (grep 'distill' in bl_procs.py and bl_selfcheck.py: no match). Its goal: backlog.py selfcheck and procs tell a session-end hook's querylog.py distill (reparented to pid 1 while it delivers, seconds old) from an orphan a worker left: such a process is named as a hook in flight, with its age, and does not fail the orphans check while younger than a named limit (SP-flkl5gom close: the first run pass's selfcheck FAILed orphans on three 12-second-old distill processes from the operator's /clear, which finished on their own). A planted test proves a young distill process does not fail the check and an old stray process still does.
